note: Independent re-audit against RFC 4724 Section 4.2 and current gr.go/gr_state.go (post-18b491ae23). Section 4.2 requires deleting all retained stale routes if the session is not re-established within the peer's advertised Restart Time. onSessionReestablished still clears restartDeadline and stops restartTimer on reconnect, while handleTimerExpired without LLGR clears peer state and invokes onTimerExpired -> releaseRoutes -> release-routes. All 7 tagged units verified: TestGRStateManagerTimerExpiry checks state removal and expiry callback; TestRFC4724RestartTimeExpiryDeletesTheStaleRoutes proves a real 1s Restart Time dispatches source release-routes; TestRFC4724ZeroRestartTimeExpiresAfterStaleMarking proves exact retain/mark-stale/release-routes ordering and real RIB deletion on both JSON and structured paths; TestGRStateManagerReconnectWithFBit, TestGRStateManagerRestartExpiryRejectsOldCycle, TestGRStateManagerRestartExpiryAfterReconnect, and TestRFC4724ReestablishedWithinRestartTimeKeepsTheRoutes verify timely re-establishment cancels expiry and keeps routes.
